source: .tools/blender/crew_body.py (Blender 5.2, builds the model and its clips from nothing)
coordinate_system: Y-up, faces +Z; one exported unit is one meter

asset_contract.title: Crew body
asset_contract.summary: A chunky, rounded 2 m crewmate (about 5.5 heads): canvas tunic, teal trousers, russet boots and belt, a red scarf. Placeholder body for crew-animation S2.
asset_contract.placement: Pivot between the feet, on the ground. Height 2.0 m, matching the player's 2 m capsule.
asset_contract.skeleton: Unity humanoid bone names (Hips, Spine, Chest, Neck, Head, Left/Right Shoulder, UpperArm, LowerArm, Hand, UpperLeg, LowerLeg, Foot, Toes); T-pose rest.
asset_contract.clips: Idle (3 s), Run (0.6 s, 7 m/s), Sprint (0.4 s, 12.6 m/s), Jump (1 s, rising), Fall (1 s); in place, looping, 60 fps.
asset_contract.materials: CrewBody_Tunic, CrewBody_Trousers, CrewBody_Skin, CrewBody_Boots, CrewBody_Scarf, CrewBody_Hair; CrewBodyAssetBuilder swaps each for a library material (M_ShipCanvas, M_ShipIron, M_ShipDeck, M_CampLeather, M_ShipPennant, M_ShipWalls).
asset_contract.collision: None; the player's CharacterController is the body's collider.
